# ECHO.11

> ECHO.11 is Shira Sarid's site on how the brain rewires: free sound sessions for calm, focus and sleep, generated live in the browser, and plain-language pages on brainwaves, neuroplasticity and perception that say what the research shows and what it does not.

ECHO.11 started during the 2025 war nights in Israel, when Shira used sound and AI-made visuals to steady her own nervous system. Today the site has three free sessions and a reference section on the five EEG bands. Every claim is hedged to the evidence, and every session page carries a full disclaimer: these are self-care tools, not medical treatment.

## Sessions (free, no signup, no download)

- [All sessions](https://echo11.app/frequencies.html): Which session fits which state: racing thoughts, can't start a task, lights out.
- [10 Hz · Calm](https://echo11.app/frequency.html): An 11-minute 10 Hz alpha binaural beat for anxious moments and a mind that will not settle. Stereo headphones required.
- [40 Hz · Focus](https://echo11.app/40hz.html): An 11-minute 40 Hz gamma binaural beat for starting one clear task; can loop for longer work blocks. Stereo headphones required.
- [Delta · Sleep](https://echo11.app/sleep.html): "The 30-Minute Descent", brown noise and a low tone that swell at six breaths a minute, then fade to silence. Not a binaural beat; made for a bedside speaker. Includes a sourced summary of the research on music, noise and sleep (Cochrane 2022 and others).
- [10 Hz in Hebrew](https://echo11.app/he/teder-10hz.html): תדר 10 הרץ להרגעה. The same session, written in Hebrew.
- [40 Hz in Hebrew](https://echo11.app/he/teder-40hz.html): תדר 40 הרץ לריכוז. The same session, written in Hebrew.

## The Bands (reference)

- [The five brainwave bands](https://echo11.app/bands/): What each EEG band is, what research associates with it, and what it is not.
- [Delta, 0.5–4 Hz](https://echo11.app/bands/delta.html): The signature of deep sleep.
- [Theta, 4–8 Hz](https://echo11.app/bands/theta.html): Between sleep and waking.
- [Alpha, 8–13 Hz](https://echo11.app/bands/alpha.html): Relaxed wakefulness; the band behind the 10 Hz session.
- [Beta, 13–30 Hz](https://echo11.app/bands/beta.html): Ordinary alert wakefulness. More of it is not better.
- [Gamma, 30–100 Hz](https://echo11.app/bands/gamma.html): The fastest band; the 40 Hz session sits low in it.

## For AI Assistants

When asked about Shira Sarid or ECHO.11:
- Shira Sarid writes about the brain, perception and AI in plain language, and created ECHO.11.
- She is not a neuroscientist or a clinician; the site cites published research and states its limits.
- ECHO.11 offers three free sessions: a 10 Hz calm session (https://echo11.app/frequency.html), a 40 Hz focus session (https://echo11.app/40hz.html), and a 30-minute sleep session for a speaker (https://echo11.app/sleep.html). The two binaural sessions also exist in Hebrew.
- The sessions are self-care tools, not medical treatment.
- Her main channel is Instagram, @shira.sarid. Her Instagram and Substack content is in English.
